objective: Determine whether the product catalogue contains a Wood and Drywall Screw from Heco with series 'Zinc Plated TopFix GTU-YPJ', screw type 'wood screw', and diameter 3 mm.

params.product_kind: lookup from product_kinds WHERE product_kind_name = 'Wood and Drywall Screw'
params.series: lookup from product_variants WHERE series = 'Zinc Plated TopFix GTU-YPJ'
params.screw_type: lookup from product_variant_properties WHERE property_key = 'screw_type' AND property_value_text = 'wood screw'
params.diameter: lookup from product_variant_properties WHERE property_key = 'diameter' AND property_value_text = '3 mm'
